title: Tell change verifiers to cite recorded checks, not rerun the suite
summary: Add one short instruction (under ~100 tokens) to the change-capability verifier prompt: cite the recorded fmt/clippy/test results under "Checks Athena ran on this tree" instead of rerunning the full suite, running them only if missing or failed. Add a CHANGELOG entry citing the 2026-10-18 verifier timeouts. Audience: verifiers and the maintainer reading the diff.

defaults_applied.how: One prompt sentence plus a changelog line.
Budgets and athena-context tests named as behavior criteria.
Criteria check the prompt text and budget test outcomes.
Changelog entry cites the dated cause.
BRIEF.md asks for tagged releases and a changelog, so the change records itself in CHANGELOG.md.

assumptions: Per the user's reply, the instruction goes only in the change verifier prompt because the study set is at 1296/1300 tokens.
The producer runs only targeted tests while editing and the full suite at most once.

acceptance_criteria.text: crates/athena-cap-change/prompts/verifier.md tells the verifier that the fmt, clippy and test results under 'Checks Athena ran on this tree' are recorded for this candidate: cite them and do not rerun the full cargo test suite; 'cargo test passes' is met by citing the record.
The prompt says a failed or missing recorded check is not a pass and the verifier may then run just that check; new behavior is exercised with targeted commands like `cargo test -p <crate> <filter>`.
CHANGELOG.md has an entry naming the 2026-10-18 verifier timeouts (full suite about 11 minutes) as the reason.
The diff touches only crates/athena-cap-change/prompts/verifier.md and CHANGELOG.md: not the shared crates/athena-context/prompts/verifier.md, no Rust source, no config.
Run `cargo test --locked -p athena-cli --test budgets -- --nocapture`; it passes and the change set stays within its 1300-token budget (was 1147).
Run `cargo test -p athena-context`; it passes, showing brief snapshot tests are unbroken.

out_of_scope: Shared crates/athena-context/prompts/verifier.md and the study verifier prompt
Producer watchdog, checkpoint or retry machinery
departures: Scope is now narrow and the user supplied the exact file and budget check, so acceptance and pass odds are higher than the reference.
